newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT sees substantinal improvement.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT sees substantinal improvement.

text.p: Dutch paper, office equipment and printing machinery group NV Koninklijke KNP BT said on Friday it expected a substantinal improvement in 1997 results compared to 1996.

"KNP BT reiterates its earlier forecast that the group's profit, assuming that the paper market does not slow down, will show a substantial improvement in the current year compared to 1996," KNP BT said.
The company said in March it expected a lower first-quarter profit but added it was keeping its full-year 1997 forecast that earnings from ordinary operations would improve.
Earlier KNP BT said first quarter 1997 net profit from ordinary operations was 52 million guilders versus 50 million guilders in the same period of 1996.
